prompt: Listen and choose the best response.
promptZh: 請聽錄音，選出最適當的回應。
spokenPrompt: Which receipt do I need to pick up my repaired boots?
spokenPromptZh: 我要拿哪張收據來取修好的靴子？

options.text: We'll have them ready by four.
options.zh: 我們最遲會在四點準備好。
options.whyZh: 這只說明最遲幾點修好，沒有回答要出示哪一張收據。

options.text: The one marked with your claim number.
options.zh: 有註明你取件號碼的那一張。
options.whyZh: 題幹問要帶哪張收據；「the one marked with your claim number」指印有取件號碼的那張，用來辨認應出示的收據。

options.text: You can pay for the repair when you get here.
options.zh: 你到這裡後再付修理費即可。
options.whyZh: 說明何時付款，沒有辨識應帶哪張收據。

explanationZh: 題幹問要帶哪張收據；「the one marked with your claim number」指印有取件號碼的那張，用來辨認應出示的收據。

vocabulary.note: 可在收據上辨識應領取的物品。
指到店領回已修好的靴子。

evidence: Which receipt do I need to pick up my repaired boots? / The one marked with your claim number.
